evidence.excerpt: World Economic Forum profile: Anne-Laure de Chammard is Group Executive Vice President and Executive Board Member of Siemens Energy, leading the Transformation of Industry business area. Siemens Energy's Executive Board (company site, Wikipedia): Christian Bruch, President and CEO; Maria Ferraro, CFO; Karim Amin (Gas Services); Tim Holt (Grid Technologies); Anne-Laure de Chammard (Transformation of Industry); Vinod Philip (global functions). No chief marketing officer is named.

Siemens Energy press release, 25 Aug 2026: the company is starting preparations for the legal and operational separation of its Transformation of Industry business area (around 17,000 employees, €5.7 billion revenue in fiscal 2025; industrial steam turbines, compressors, generators, motors, hydrogen electrolysers, maritime and subsea technologies) into a standalone company. It will initially operate under Siemens Energy's future Omterra brand once launched. In a second step Siemens Energy intends to explore a new ownership structure, from bringing in external investors to a potential capital markets transaction, with the objective of deconsolidating the business while retaining a meaningful minority stake. Major manufacturing in Germany and facilities across Europe, the United States, India, China, Brazil and Saudi Arabia. No timeline given. Corroborated by Bloomberg (25 Aug 2026) and Yahoo Finance/OilPrice.

Siemens Energy Q3 FY2026 earnings release (5 Aug 2026, quarter April-June 2026): Transformation of Industry orders up 31.5% to €1.81 billion and revenue up 11.5% to €1.53 billion, led by the Compression new-units business and large orders from the Americas; fiscal 2026 outlook for the unit 5-7% comparable revenue growth at an 11-13% margin before special items. Group: record orders €17.9 billion, revenue €11.4 billion.

Bloomberg, 24 Aug 2026: Siemens Energy has tapped Goldman Sachs to advise on a stake sale of the Transformation of Industry division; CVC Capital Partners, EQT, Bain Capital, Brookfield and KKR are among buyout firms considering bids for a majority stake, in a deal that could value the division at more than €10 billion. Reported, not company-confirmed; the 25 Aug release names no bidders or valuation.

Siemens Energy press release, 14 Jul 2026: Siemens Energy and Siemens Gamesa will become Omterra. The move follows the time-limited licence agreement for the Siemens brand after the 2020 spin-off (a revenue-linked royalty of roughly €300 million in the most recent year, agreement running to 2030); the rebrand begins later in 2026 and is implemented in stages. Corroborated by POWER Magazine and Energy Digital.

Formula E, 20 Mar 2026: Opel announces its entry into the ABB FIA Formula E World Championship from Season 13 (2026/27), the start of the GEN4 era, as the Opel GSE Formula E Team, a Rüsselsheim-based organisation led by Team Principal and Motorsport Director Jörg Schrott. Announced by Formula E CEO Jeff Dodds and Opel CEO Florian Huettl. Opel enters with its own manufacturer licence, taking the grid to 12 teams and 24 cars, and helps Stellantis develop the GEN4 powertrain used by the group's factory teams (RACER, Motorsport Week, Autosport).

Stellantis media (Opel), 8 Jul 2026: Sparco becomes the official technical partner for the racing clothing of the Opel GSE Formula E Team's regular drivers and of test/development driver Sophia Flörsch for 2026/27, extending the Opel Motorsport rally partnership. Drivers: Mitch Evans (Autosport) and Théo Pourchaire (Stellantis media). No other commercial partner of the team has been announced as of 11 Sep 2026 (searched fiaformulae.com, Stellantis media, Opel press).

Porsche Newsroom / Siemens Energy press: Siemens Energy is co-developer and systems integrator of the Haru Oni e-fuels plant in Chilean Patagonia with Porsche, AME, ENAP and Enel — wind power, PEM electrolysers for green hydrogen, synthesis to methanol and e-fuel; pilot output ~130,000 litres from 2022.

Sponsor table: ABB is Formula E championship title partner (since 2018). Porsche Formula E Team — TDK official technology partner; industrial software / digital twin locked by AVEVA (Schneider Electric). Envision Racing — Envision Group (renewables / clean tech) parent, Paysafe title from Season 13, Sand Technologies, Teijin. Lola Yamaha ABT — Shell (energy / lubricants). Jaguar TCS Racing — TCS title, Castrol. DS Penske — TotalEnergies, Mouser, TTI, Molex, KYOCERA AVX. Mahindra Racing — Mahindra & Mahindra, Tech Mahindra. Andretti Formula E — TWG AI, Quest Global, Crowe UK, Reflo, Nissan powertrain from Season 13. Nissan Formula E Team — Nagase, Coral, Crowe, Castrol (unverified for S12). Opel GSE Formula E Team — Opel, Stellantis, Sparco. F1: Siemens on Oracle Red Bull Racing and Visa Cash App Racing Bulls.

Season 13 (2026/27) calendar table: Jeddah E-Prix double-header opens the season on 18-19 December 2026; Berlin E-Prix 8-9 May 2027; London E-Prix 29-30 May 2027; Zandvoort E-Prix 18-19 June 2027; Madrid E-Prix 26-27 June 2027; Tokyo finale 24-25 July 2027.

brief.deck: Siemens Energy is carving out Transformation of Industry, its 17,000-person, €5.7B-revenue business in compressors, steam turbines, motors, drives and electrolysers, into a standalone company, announced 25 August 2026, with outside investors or a listing to follow and the Omterra brand at launch.
brief.the_case_p1: On 25 August Siemens Energy said it is preparing the separation of Transformation of Industry, the business area making industrial steam turbines, compressors, generators, motors, drives and hydrogen electrolysers. It employs around 17,000 people and generated €5.7B of revenue in fiscal 2025; in the quarter to June, orders rose 31.5% to €1.81B and revenue 11.5% to €1.53B. Siemens Energy intends to deconsolidate the unit while keeping a meaningful minority stake, from external investors to a capital-markets transaction. Bloomberg reports Goldman Sachs advising and CVC, EQT, Bain, Brookfield and KKR weighing bids above €10B.
brief.the_case_p2: A business becoming a company has one job in its first year: tell the market who it is. This one starts under the Omterra name, created because the licence to the Siemens brand from the 2020 spin-off is time-limited, then meets owners who judge it on growth. Industrial electrification is its story, and Formula E is the world championship built on that story. Germany is where its factories and its launch audience sit.
brief.why_now_callout: <font name='Poppins-Bold' size='9'>WHY NOW</font>  The separation was announced on 25 August; the brand launches later this year and the ownership decision follows. A launch partner has to be agreed before its first budget is set. Season 13 opens at the Jeddah E-Prix on 18-19 December; the Berlin E-Prix, the home round, follows on 8-9 May 2027.
brief.why_team_label: WHY OPEL GSE FORMULA E TEAM
brief.why_team_para: Opel enters Formula E in Season 13 with its own manufacturer licence and a team built from scratch in Rüsselsheim under Jörg Schrott; the only partner announced so far is Sparco for racewear, so every commercial category is open. A German industrial-electrification brand launching in the same season as a German works team gives both a founding-partner story with a Berlin home round. The Stellantis GEN4 powertrain the team helps develop is the audience the company sells to.
brief.value_section_label: VALUE TO OPEL GSE FORMULA E TEAM
brief.value_content: MODE B - commercial and brand. Transformation of Industry sells motors, drives, compressors and electrolysers to industrial buyers; the Berlin, London, Madrid and Zandvoort paddocks are a hospitality platform for those customers and for the investors choosing its owners. For Opel: a founding technology partner with an industrial-decarbonisation story, launch co-branding, and hardware for the Rüsselsheim workshop and trackside energy setup.
brief.deal_arch_para: Entry as Founding Industrial Technology Partner. <font name='Poppins-Bold' size='9.5'>THREE YEARS</font>, Seasons 13-15, spanning the brand launch, the ownership change and a probable listing. Estimated €2-4M a year. Scope: sidepod or rear-wing placement, naming of the team's energy and workshop infrastructure, Berlin and London hospitality, and engineering content.

Sourced today on the operator's ask ("Source a signal today for FE") after the morning run produced no eligible signal (0 of 11; the routine's five FE names were all already full cases). Each claim was checked against the search summary of the primary page named as the evidence URL, corroborated by at least one secondary outlet. ## The trigger, honestly labelled

The 25 Aug 2026 release is company-announced: separation of Transformation of Industry into a standalone company, ~17,000 employees, €5.7B FY25 revenue, minority stake retained, options from external investors to a capital-markets transaction, no timeline. The Bloomberg 24 Aug story (Goldman advising; CVC, EQT, Bain, Brookfield, KKR; >€10B) is REPORTED and says so in the brief. The Omterra name (14 Jul 2026 release) is the future brand of Siemens Energy and Siemens Gamesa; the carved-out business will initially operate under it. The desk's 5 Sep screen-out of "Omterra (Siemens Energy)" stands: that row conflated the brand with the carve-out. This case is the corrected framing, dated to the carve-out.

## Team choice

Opel GSE Formula E Team was not in the desk's team table (a Season 13 entrant). Added today to `seeds/team_profiles.json` and `seeds/sponsors.json` from fiaformulae.com (20 Mar 2026 entry announcement) and Stellantis media (Sparco, 8 Jul 2026), with per-row sources. Ruled out by name in the brief: Porsche (AVEVA/Schneider lock, TDK), Envision (Envision Group is an energy-technology competitor; Paysafe title), Lola Yamaha ABT (Shell), Andretti (TWG AI, Quest Global, US story, Nissan powertrain), Mahindra (Mahindra/Tech Mahindra), Jaguar (TCS, Castrol), DS Penske (TotalEnergies + electronics roster); Nissan, Citroën and Cupra Kiro open but without the German launch story.

## Decision path

Anne-Laure de Chammard — Executive Board member responsible for Transformation of Industry (WEF profile; Siemens Energy Executive Board listing; Siemens Energy appointment release). Path: Christian Bruch (President and CEO), Maria Ferraro (CFO). No chief marketing officer is named for Siemens Energy or the standalone; the standalone's CEO has not been announced. `leadership_ties`: none found after checking de Chammard, Bruch and Ferraro for F1 / Formula E history.
